core_obligations: Take Q^bullet = eta_I M^bullet as a representative of L eta_I M and reduce to the affine local case (proof lines 13546-13552).
Choose a good affine chart with the ideals I_i(M^bullet, f) principal and the terms finite free, and replace M^bullet over it by a bounded finite free complex N^bullet (proof lines 13554-13562).
Use principality to see that eta_f N^bullet is bounded with finite locally free terms and identify the pieces through the stalks lemma (proof lines 13564-13567).
proof_roadmap: The representative and the reduction to affine local (proof lines 13546-13552).
The good chart and the finite free model (proof lines 13554-13562).
Boundedness, local freeness and the stalks comparison (proof lines 13564-13567).
difficulty_reason: Letting X, D, I, M be as in Situation labelled situation-complex-and-divisor with (X, D, M) a good triple, the lemma says that if M is represented by a locally bounded complex M^bullet of finite locally free O_X-modules, then L eta_I M is represented by a locally bounded complex Q^bullet of finite locally free O_{X'}-modules (statement lines 13534-13544). The proof takes Q^bullet = eta_I M^bullet, which represents L eta_I M by Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-Leta, and reduces the boundedness and local freeness checks to the affine local case, where boundedness is clear (proof lines 13546-13552). It then chooses an affine chart (U, A, f, M^bullet) for (X, D, M) with the ideals I_i(M^bullet, f) principal and with each M^i|_U finite free, which is possible because the triple is good, and writes N^i = Gamma(U, M^i|_U) to obtain a bounded complex N^bullet of finite free A-modules representing the same object of D(A) as M^bullet by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-affine-compare-bounded (proof lines 13554-13562). Since I_i(N^bullet, f) is principal for all i by More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-ideal-well-defined, the complex eta_f N^bullet is bounded with finite locally free terms, and because Q^i|_U corresponds to eta_f N^i by Lemma labelled lemma-eta-stalks the conclusion follows (proof lines 13564-13567). Passing from an arbitrary locally free representative to a finite free complex on a good affine chart, so that the principal-ideal hypothesis makes eta_f preserve finite locally freeness, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
